answer: The lotus index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the walnut queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1506 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the summit. A 162 account operation therefore ties up 17 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
